name: Soldier Fortune

specialAbility.name: Air Strike
specialAbility.description: Soldier Fortune calls in a massive air strike from above, dropping 35 points of boom right on the enemy's head!

lore: Reporting for duty! Soldier Fortune is a battle-hardened military truck that treats every race like a mission. Covered head to tire in army camo and wearing its dog tags with pride, this tough truck never retreats and never surrenders. When it calls in an Air Strike, the whole arena ducks for cover. Sir, yes sir!
